input.title: 20bb · Flop · Low hearts
input.description: A complete saved flop-to-river game on 6h 5h 3c at 20bb initial depth, with a 6bb pot and 17bb behind. The declared ranges include an overpair, a set, top pairs, pair-plus-straight draws and heart draws. Half-pot, pot, all-in and one subsequent raise are modeled across all three streets.
input.rangeAssumptions: Illustrative starting ranges: BTN AA/A6s/87s and BB 55/64s/A4s, equal weight per unblocked exact combination. These ranges are stated study assumptions, not certified preflop frequencies or outputs of a solved earlier line. All later betting and ordered card arrivals use one joint conditional game. This is a saved 20bb flop study, not validation or replacement of the existing full-hand 20bb model. Rake-free Home game. Player 0 is BTN; player 1 is BB.
